2607.22898.title: AssumptionMiner: Extracting, Tracing, and Revising Implicit Assumptions in LLM Code Generation
2607.22898.paper_summary: Large language models (LLMs) generate code from natural-language prompts, yet real-world prompts rarely provide complete specifications. When prompts leave input formats, error handling, or design decisions unspecified, LLMs fill these gaps with implicit assumptions that shape the generated code's behavior and correctness. Because these assumptions remain hidden, generated code may satisfy tests while violating developer intent. We present AssumptionMiner, a framework that makes implicit assumptions a first-class artifact of LLM-based code generation. In addition to code, AssumptionMiner produces an explicit assumption layer, a structured representation of inferred constraints and design decisions that developers can inspect, confirm, or revise. An AST-based dependency graph enables targeted regeneration of only the code affected by a revised assumption. We also introduce a benchmark of 180 ambiguous programming tasks with 676 annotated assumptions, including a human-verified subset for evaluating code localization. We evaluate assumption extraction, code localization, and assumption-guided regeneration. Across open-source LLMs, a confidence-weighted ensemble achieves an F1 score of 0.816 for assumption extraction, improving on the strongest offline baseline by 3.6x. On the human-verified localization benchmark, AST-guided localization identifies more precise code regions than keyword-based and whole-file baselines. During assumption revision, targeted regeneration modifies less code than non-targeted alternatives while exposing challenges in handling cascading edits. These results demonstrate that making assumptions explicit improves the transparency and controllability of LLM-based code generation.
2607.22898.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）從自然語言提示生成代碼，但現實世界的提示很少提供完整的規範。當提示未明確輸入格式、錯誤處理或設計決策時，LLMs 會用隱含假設填補這些空白，這些假設會影響生成代碼的行為和正確性。由於這些假設保持隱藏，生成的代碼可能滿足測試卻違背開發者的意圖。我們提出了 AssumptionMiner，一個將隱含假設作為 LLM 基於代碼生成的第一類工件的框架。除了代碼，AssumptionMiner 還生成一個明確的假設層，這是一種結構化的推斷約束和設計決策的表示，開發者可以檢查、確認或修訂。基於 AST 的依賴圖使得僅針對修訂假設影響的代碼進行有針對性的再生成成為可能。我們還介紹了一個包含 180 個模糊編程任務和 676 個註釋假設的基準，包括一個經人類驗證的子集，用於評估代碼定位。我們評估了假設提取、代碼定位和假設引導的再生成。在開源 LLM 中，一個基於置信度加權的集成方法在假設提取中達到了 0.816 的 F1 分數，比最強的離線基準提高了 3.6 倍。在經人類驗證的定位基準上，AST 引導的定位識別出比基於關鍵字和整個文件基準更精確的代碼區域。在假設修訂過程中，有針對性的再生成修改的代碼比非針對性的替代方案少，同時暴露了處理級聯編輯的挑戰。這些結果表明，使假設明確化提高了基於 LLM 的代碼生成的透明度和可控性。
2607.22898.author: Jie "JW" Wu et.al.
